requirement: v3.2.5: make importing a large-model token in the decision center work -- prefill the DeepSeek preset, omit blank fields so the server preset lookup is not defeated by empty strings, and surface 4xx reasons instead of a bare HTTP status

assertions.root_cause: the form sent provider/model/baseUrl as empty strings when left blank; normalizeAiProfile reads String(input.provider ?? 'deepseek') and an empty string is not nullish, so the preset lookup failed with unknown-provider; 4xx bodies also carry `reason`, while the client only read `error`, hiding the cause behind HTTP 400
assertions.form: the AI settings form prefills deepseek / deepseek-flash / https://api.deepseek.com/v1 and submits only non-empty fields, so pasting a key alone now saves through the provider preset
assertions.errors: dcRequest throws body.error ?? body.reason ?? HTTP status, so a rejected save names unknown-provider / api-key-required / base-url-required
assertions.feedback: a successful save reports the stored provider/model instead of a bare 已保存
assertions.key_setup: the operator key was validated against POST /v1/chat/completions (model deepseek-flash, HTTP 200) and persisted in the host data dir with the plugin's own DPAPI(CurrentUser) format; the plugin's createAiSecretStore().load() reads it back as provider=deepseek model=deepseek-flash backend=dpapi, so the advisor is configured after the next start
assertions.suites: client-bundle 36/36; claims green with the network skip; eslint 0 errors
